description: This is a PHP unit test class for the RefreshTokenRepository within an OAuth-related plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It tests functionalities such as creating, persisting, revoking, and checking revocation status of refresh tokens.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepositoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the RefreshTokenRepository's behavior with refresh tokens in OAuth implementation within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads fixture data, and instantiates the repository before each test.

methods.name: testGetNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Validates that a new refresh token instance can be created.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Tests persisting a new refresh token and verifies its properties after saving.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessTokenWithExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown when attempting to persist a refresh token with a duplicate identifier.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessToken
methods.description: Tests revoking a refresh token and confirms the revoked status.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessTokenWhichAlreadyRevoked
methods.description: Checks that revoking an already revoked token does not alter its state.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that revoking a non-existent token does not cause errors.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Tests querying the revocation status of existing tokens.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevokedForNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that a non-existent token is reported as revoked.
